Bird Wyverns of Ruin?
description: Do you know the Felyne Tsukino, who appears in the mew MONSTER HUNTER STORIES 2: WINGS OF RUIN? She's so cute! Complete this quest and I'll give you materials to gorge layered armor to make your Palico look just like her!

name: Gotta Hoard Fast!
description: Oh no! Looks like Sonic dropped all of his rings! If you help us collect them all, I'll set you up with some materials for layed armor that will make you look just like us! And there's an extra reward if you do it really fast!

name: Rising Sun!?
description: I've got a special quest fur-om OKAMI for ya! Collect the cargo strewn about the Shrine Ruins and I'll give you the materials to create layered armor that'll make your Palamute look like the legendary Sun Goddess!

name: Heart of a Warrior
objective: Hunt a Goss Harag and Magnamalo
description: Hey, Squirt! We've got ourselves a little quest that'll determine who's the strongest hunter. My zenny's on you, but we'll see! All ya gotta do is go smack around a Goss Harag and Magnamalo in the Arena and these titles are yours! Think you're up to it? Well go get to it! Bwahahaha!

name: The Tiniest Snowbaron!
description: Ah, Hunter! Our little Komitsu asked me to illustrate some Bombadgy pictures for her. She loved them so much, I turned them into stickers! Johoho! Complete my request, and they're yours! Now...hop to it-to it!

name: Dastardly Vile Aknosom Trio
description: What's wrong, Hunter? The winter days got you feeling chilly? Well, I've got just the thing to warm your spirits! Johoho! I've made some new stickers and they're wonderfully wintery! Complete my request, and they're yours! Now...hop to it-to it!

name: For a Song and a Rain Dance
Soaring Desire
objective: Slay a Royal Ludroth, a Pukei-Pukei and a Bishaten
description: Sup! Heard you've been doin' it up out there in the field. I've been doin' my thing too, especially after ol' Hanenaga taught me about the Wirebug. I'd teach you if I didn't have to do this quest... If you take care of it for me, I'll hook you up with some sick Wirebug poses!

name: Wrestling with Pain
objective: Hunt an Arzuros and a Tetranadon
description: Ow-ow-ow... Sittin' down at work all these years has done a number on my back... Your back's gonna be busted too if you don't learn to sit right! Look at ya slouchin'! Tell you what, do this here quest and I'll teach ya all about posture!

name: Dual Threat: A Returning Rush of Red
Dual Threat: A Song of Silver and Gold
Dual Threat: Go Out with a Bang!
Knight in Shattered Armor
description: I've got a special quest fur-om Ghosts 'n Goblins Resurrection for ya! I need you to hunt three monsters covered in an eerie red aura. Get it done, and I'll give you the materials to forge a courageous knight's armor!

name: Nothing to Sneeze At!
description: Ah...ah...ACHOO! Sorry... *sniff* Ugh... Caught a cold somewhere between the Frost Islands and Lava Caverns... If I'm ever gonna study Bisha...AH...ACHOOO! *sniff* Bishaten, I'll need your help. In return, I'll teach you some poses that vividly express my misery...

name: Out of Sight, Out of Mind's Eye
description: After the most brutal training, I have become one with the shadows and achieved enlightenment. However, a Tetranadon hinders my training. I will bestow my wisdom upon any who can defeat it.

name: The Blue Bomber's Best Bud
description: I've got a special quest fur-om the Mega Man series for ya! There's a Zinogre in there that may be small, but I have a bone to pick with. Hunt it, and I'll give you the materials to forge Mega Man's trusty companion!

name: Troubled Waters
description: I hunt for ancient tresure that lies in the deepest rivers and oceans. Sadly, my next diving spot is swimming with monsters. Would you clear them out for me? If you o, I'll give you the materials to make some new layered armor.

name: A Good old-Fashioned Rampage
description: M-My goodness! All the terrors that hunters fought off in the past have shown up in this Rampage! You're a fresh-faced hunter how, but you'll go down in history if you can defeat them. And if you do, I'll give you some materials to make some layered armor!

name: Advance: Crimson Calamity
description: The ancient tomes say it is an evil star -- a peculiar comet that glows an ominous red. Each coming day, the crimson hue grows fiercer and soon threatens to sunder the very earth. Only you hold the power to bring down this evil from the sky.

name: Advanced: Born of Paradise
objective: Slay Wind Serpent Ibushi and Narwa the Allmother
description: Wind Serpent Ibushi and Thunder Serpent Narwa...in other words: the Allmother has risen once again in the Coral Palace. And judging by this existential dread I'm feeling right now, with more power than ever before... Please be careful!

name: Almudron: Fashion Victim
description: Rondine showed me a pair of tight pants from some far off country. I don't know fashion, but I know a pair of sturdy pants when I see 'em! Complete my request, and I'll give you the materials to forge 'em.

name: An Icy Blade So Bright
description: I just don't understand young hunters and their "fashion"... Some of them even paint their glasses solid black! It boggles the mind! Well, if this sort of thing interests you, complete my request and I'll give you the materials to make them.

name: Apex Arzuros Emergency
description: Urgent notice from the Hunter's Guild: Unique Apex sighted, requesting its elimination ASAP. Monster appears to be far more dangerous than any Apex to date. Retreat if deemed too dangerous.

name: Apex Diablos Emergency
description: Urgent notice from the Hunter's Guild: Unique Apex sighted, requesting its elimination ASAP. Monster appears to be far more dangerous than any Apex to date. Retreat if deemed too dangerous.

description: Urgent notice from the Hunter's Guild: Unique Apex sighted, requesting its elimination ASAP. Monster appears to be far more dangerous than any Apex to date. Retreat if deemed too dangerous.

description: Urgent notice from the Hunter's Guild: Unique Apex sighted, requesting its elimination ASAP. Monster appears to be far more dangerous than any Apex to date. Retreat if deemed too dangerous.

name: Apex Zinogre Emergency
description: Urgent notice from the Hunter's Guild: Unique Apex sighted, requesting its elimination ASAP. Monster appears to be far more dangerous than any Apex to date. Retreat if deemed too dangerous.

name: Beast of the Shadows
description: Ah, Hunter! The illustrations I was working on turned out so well that I decided to make them into a stickers! What do you think? Adorable, are they not? Complete my request, and they're yours! Now... hop to it-to it!

name: Blazin' Soul of a Warrior
description: They say the soul of a true warrior burns bright like a fire, blazin' a path for the next generation. Magnamalo's soul is a scorchin' inferno of hatred. Tormented by its insatiable hunger... Hunter of Kumura! Go forth and show us whose soul burns brightest!

name: Boomy Dango
description: Ah, Hunter! Hinoa asked me to make some dango stickers and, I must say, just looking at them makes my mouth water! Johoho! Complete my request, and they're yours! Now... hop to it-to it!

name: Clouds of Narwa Rumble Again
description: Worrying news indeed... Narwa has been spotted in the Coral Palace. Fortunately, it has yet to meet up with its king, but I have a terrible feeling... Hunter, you must leap into action at once. We cannot allow them to reunite!

name: Dancing Parasol, Snowy Breeze
description: Ah, Hunter! Minoto asked me to make some Cahoot stickers and, johoho, they came out better than expected! Wouldn't you agree? Complete my request, and they're yours! Now... hop to it-to it!

name: Diablos Deception
description: Two Apex Diablos have been spotted in the Sandy Plains. Hinoa reports that their sizes differ substantially and they're going wild. Seeing them next to each other, it's hard to tell which one's nearby and which one's far away, so be careful!

name: Fooled in the Flooded Forest
description: Shhh! Don't mind me! I ran into a Chameleos and now I'm stalling for time playing possum. But I don't think I can fool it for much longer! If you can take care of it for me, I'll teach ya my trick for getting out of a bind!

name: Frost Bites
objective: Hunt a Lagombi, a Barioth, and a Goss Harag
description: Help us! HELP US! Anyone! Our safari has been surrounded by monsters, and now we're stuck out in the cold! Good thing I wore something warm and I'll give you some materials to make your very own if you get those monsters to scram!

name: Gales of Ibushi Blow Again
description: Worrying news indeed... Ibushi has been spotted in the Coral Palace. Fortunately, it has yet to meet up with its queen, but I have a terrible feeling... Hunter, you must leap into action at once. We cannot allow them to reunite!

name: Haste Makes Waste
description: Seems like power alone isn't enough these days -- hunters want to look intelligent too. I'd take brawn over brains any day... I guess times are changing. Complete this request, and I'll give you the required materials.

name: Heart of Might
description: Hey, Squirt. We got some of the mightiest elder dragons out in the Infernal Springs. Are they too mightly for ya to brawl with? Only one way to find out. Take 'em down and I'll give ya some new titles. Sound good? Now get to it!

name: Heart of Rivalry
objective: Slay an Apex Mizutsune and an Apex Zinogre
description: Hey, squirt! An Apex Mizutsune and an Apex Zinogre are goin' at it out in the Flooded Forest. Who's gonna come out on top? Well, my zenny's on you because I'm sendin' ya out there! Take 'em down and I'll give ya some new titles! Now go get to it!

name: Heart of a Hero
objective: Hunt a Tigrex and a Diablos
description: Hey, Hunter! There's a deathmatch raging on in the Arena between a teeny-tiny Tigrex and a dango-droppingly big Diablos! If you can go over and quiet that racket down. I'll give ya some new titles. Sound good? Good! Now go get to it!

name: Heart of a Ninja
description: Hey, Squirt! We've got ourselves another little quest in the Arena that'll test the best of the best. Complete it and you'll snag some new titles for yourself. Now these monsters think they're slick but my zenny's on you! Go get to it!

name: Heart of an Apex
description: Hey, Squirt! We've got reports of a buncha Apex toughies gatherin' in one spot! Now normally these baddies would put a hunter in the dirt, but my zenny's on you. Put THEM in the dirt an these Guild Card titles are yours! Bwahaha! Now go get to it!

name: I Can't Do What Somnacan
description: I am a professional dancer, and I wish to expand my repertoire with the graceful moves of a Somnacanth! YOU hunt one while I watch safely from afar and take notes. I'll teach you a gesture as a reward!

name: Kunai Ask You a Favor?
objective: Hunt a Barroth, a Rathian and a Diablos
description: I have mastered the kunai! Swords? Bows? Hah! Don't need 'em! ...Well, at least, I thought I didn't until those monsters put me face down, tassets up in the a cart back to camp. Avenge my bruise behind and I'll teach you my kunai-accentuated poses!

name: Memories of That Day
objective: Hunt a Great Izuchi, a Mizutsune, and Magnamalo
description: (It's actually a request from a certain tailor, but it's written by Minoto...) "The reward is material for layered armor. And, uh, the armor is kind of...adorable, so...after you make it, I think I'll order another in secret..."

name: Monster Maniacs
objective: Hunt a Volvidon, an Anjanath and a Tigrex
description: I've met some crazy fans before, but these gues are foaming at the mouth to get an autograph! I know it's hard to resist my charm, but I need security to get rid of them, pronto. When they're gona, I'll teach you some super cutesy poses!

name: Princesses' Banquet
description: Ah, Hunter! There's a custom in a far-off land of giving sweets to express one's feelings. I thought it was such a nice idea that I made stickers about it! If you complete my request, I'll give them to you. Now, hop to it-to it!

name: Rajang's Holiday Special
description: Ah, Hunter! I have some johoho-vial news for you! After hearing tales of a distant land where they throw the merriest of parties, I was inspired to make some festive stickers! Complete my request, and they're yours! Now...hop to it-to it!

name: Rampage: Enchanting Parade
description: Oh my Gog! Those monsters are sooooo cute! But why do they have to be so mean? *pout* If you go out and teach them to behave, I'll teach YOU a new gesture. It's my signature move so I know you'll just love it!

name: Rampage: Kamura Night Hunt
description: A Rampage unlike any before is hurtlin' towards the village, and that fiend Ibushi is leadin' it! Be on the lookout for Magnamalo; there's a good change it'll show up for a snack. It's up to you to protect the village! Go get to it!

name: Rampage: Muddi Gras
description: Ah, Hunter! Take a look at these festive stickers I made! They are so... festive! Johoho! Really put you in the mood to celebrate, do they not? Complete my request, and they're yours! Now... hop it-to it!

name: Rampage: Rampaging Rajang
description: Attention! Rampage incoming! All hunters report to the Stronghold -- Wait wait! You! Come back here! Who taught you to run like....that!? You look like a Gargwa trying to lay an egg! Look, I gotta go warn Kamura, but if you survive this, I'll show you my running techniques.

name: SF: Ultimate Promotion Exam
description: Looking to train with the best, I see! Well, you came to the right place! My prized pupil is -- Hold on, there's two of 'em!? And the second one has a dark aura!? *shrug* Anyway, you just need to defeat one!

name: Scorching Showdown
description: They may have home advantage but if you take 'em on, we'll cheer for ya! Ready!? OK! *clap* "We've got the pride! We've got the spirit! Our hunter is the best so let 'em hear it! K-A-M-U-R-A! What's that spell? KAURA! KAMURA! Goooooo Kamura!" Wooo!

name: Super Shady Look-alike
description: I thought that dumb faker was following me around again, but turns out it was something else. I'm getting real bad vibes from it. Send it packing and I'll hook you up with some materials to make some sweet layered armor!

name: Tempest in the Desert
description: I... *wheeze* made it... *gasp* WOO! Listen...! *cough* There's a Kushala...Daora... on the loose... *gasp* You gotta do something *huff* about it...! I... ran through... the night... to warn you *wheeze* Now I need... a bit of a... lie-down...

name: Trouble in Paradise
objective: Slay an Apex Rathalos and an Apex Rathian
description: An Apex Rathalos and Rathian are hollerin' at each other over in the Shrine Ruins! They say don't get involved in a couple's fight but we better put a stop to this one before it really heats up and burns the whole place down!

name: USJ - Arzuros Onslaught!
client: Dapper Crewmate up to No Good
description: USJ presents to you a horde of Arzuros closing in like a raging tide! Ride the raging waves and claim the materials to craft Palico gear that gleams like the azure star!

name: USJ - Shrine Showdown!
objective: Hunt a Tetranadon, an Almudron, and Magnamalo
client: Dapper Crewmate up to No Good
description: USJ presents to you a thrilling battle stage with a ravenous river beast, a sly mud dweller and a beast of pure malice! Leap onto the field of battle and reap materials to craft gear that gleams like the azure star!

name: White Desert Blossom
description: Ah, Hunter! You can always count on endemic life to help you on hunts! And if you complete my request, johoho, you can count on them to help communicate with your friends! Hop to it-to it and these stickers are yours!

name: Zin an Yang
objective: Hunt a Zinogre and a Khezu
description: Oh, great! JUST GREAT. Where'd that stupid paper go!? No need to panic -- why should I panic? *ahem* Could you, um, maybe take care of the quest for me? I'll give you some materials to make layered armor if you do! And... could you keep this just between us?

Blue, Round, and Cute
description: You there! Tell me, don't you think Arzuros are the cutest!? Fuzzy blue fur, a soft tubby belly; what I wouldn't give to hug 'em! Sooo, can you capture one for m— Whaddya mean, "only if I promise not to hug it?"

name: Dancing A-purr-ition
description: Help, Hunter! I just saw this su-purr creepy umbrella monster! I tried to get close to see if it was real or if I was just i-meow-gining it and it tried to attack me! I've never been more tra-mew-tized in all my nine lives! Make it go away!

name: Dango Duty
objective: Slay a total of 20 Izuchi or Baggi
description: I heard the Frost Islands are crawling with Izuchi and Baggi! My ingredients supplier will be passing through there and the last thing I want is for them to get pounced on by some dumb monsters! Could you maybe go and check it out, pleeeeeeease?

name: Didn't Get the Memo
description: I can take a Great Baggi, no problemo! But TWO!? Nobody said anything about two of 'em! I mean, maybe if I had like a heads up or something, I'd be alright. Someone should have told me! What—!? It's written in the quest description? Come on! Nobody reads that stuff!

name: Divine Comedy
objective: Hunt an Arzuros and a Kulu-Ya-Ku
description: You're kidding me! Why's there gotta be an Arzuros AND a Kulu-Ya-Ku on my route when I've got honey and eggs to deliver!? Is this some kind of punishment from the gods!?

name: Donning Toxicity
description: I've hit a bit of a slump, and I'm looking for something to rekindle my creativity. Hmm... Aha! Yes, a Great Wroggi hide! Its vivid hues make for great inspiration, and there just so happens to be one in the area!

name: Even Cute Things Have Fangs
description: I have this Felyne friend, and she got all scared about some big fluffy bunny. But I don't get it, 'cause bunnies are supposed to be cute! Can you go check it out so she'll stop being such a scaredy-cat?

name: Honing Your Hunting Horn
objective: Hunt a Great Izuchi and Tetranadon
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Harmonize with the sounds of nature as you serenade these monster to permanent sleep and you're sure to find a new tune for the hunting horn!

name: Learning the Light Bowgun
objective: Hunt a Great Baggi and a Great Wroggi
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! The path to light bowgun mastery is paved by the Great Baggi and the Great Wroggi. Their sly and agile combat is full of potential for new hit and run tactics for this weapon!

name: Learning the Light Bowgun
objective: Hunt a Great Baggi and a Great Wroggi
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! The path to light bowgun mastery is paved by the Great Baggi and the Great Wroggi. Their sly and agile combat is full of potential for new hit and run tactics for this weapon!

name: Lost and Found
objective: Slay a total of 20 Jagras or Bullfango
description: Oh, man... On my way home, I dropped my wallet somewhere near the Ruins. My mom's gonna be SO mad if I don't bring it back, but there're too many monsters around there to go look for it... Please help me, Hunter!

name: Night of the Khezu
description: I was out fishing; everything dark and gloomy. When suddenly down flew a Khezu; slimy and gooey. Horrified to find there were no eyes that would twinkle, only a blubbery neck...veiny and wrinkled.

name: Study the Switch Axe
objective: Hunt a Lagombi and a Khezu
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! The Lagombi and the Khezu may both be white but that's where their similarities end. If you can take on this contrasting pair at once, you'll discover the essence of the switch axe.

name: Study the Sword & Shield
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! An Aknosom makes clever use of its big crest to fight, right? Understand how to maneuver around these kinds of attacks and you'll learn the very essence of the sword & shield!

name: The Frost Islands Arena
description: Oh~yeah! You're going nowhere. I've got you for fifty minutes...Fifty minutes of huntin' time! Heard this Tetranadon was out there talkin' smack. You gonna stand there and take that!? Or are ya gonna go out there and put 'em in a world of hurt!?

name: The Swirling Gale
description: For crying out loud! I moved near the Shrine Ruins because it was a nice and quiet neighborhood... Now there's a Great Izuchi and its little gang making a ruckus. I tried to give 'em a piece of my mind but they pulled their blades on me! Hunter, please get rid of 'em!

name: Totally Not Cool, Kulu!
description: A pair of Kulu-Ya-Ku is after the eggs I had dibs on for my dango! No fair, AND rude! But if you can keep them occupied, I can grab the eggs before they eat 'em. You'll help me out, right? Right?

name: Bad Review
objective: Slay a total of 20 Rhenoplos or Kestodon
description: I just got done talking to my best friend and her neighbor's daughter had THE WORST experience out in the Sandy Plains. Apparently, the locals were extremely rude and wouldn't stop butting in to her business. The nerve...

name: Bowled Over
description: Man, I cannot catch a break! I was making my way through the Plains when I started hearing this, *boingy* *boingy* *boingy* noise. Then suddenly two Volvidon appear out of nowhere and roll over my cart! To make matters worse, any produce that didn't get squashed was covered in their nasty spit!

name: Charge Blade Coalescing
objective: Hunt a Royal Ludroth and a Jyuratodus
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Like the Royal Ludroth and Jyuratodus, you'll need to be in water—Wait, no... You'll need to be "AS water." Meaning you'll have to be flexible according to the situation. Understanding this is the key to unlocking the charge blade's potential!

name: Charmed by a Queen
description: Hunter Hunter HUNTER! We must go at once! As we speak the queen herself is gracing the Shrine Ruins! I must capture her majesty in all its glory! But I hear Rathian are rather... difficult to work with. Perhaps you can assist me?

name: Flooded Forest Fiasco
objective: Slay a total of 20 Ludroth or Wroggi
description: *sniff* Papa promised we'd go fishin' 'cuz I was a good boy, I did all my chores. Brushed my teeth. Even cleaned my room! But now we can't *sniff* because *sniff* a bunch of dumb monsters. *sob* It's not fair! *sniff*

name: Foul Play in the Forest
description: Hey, listen here. Don't go tellin' people what I'm about to tell you, capiche? Some of our "special ingredients" come from the Flooded Forest, but now some rivals are tryin' to move in on our turf. This is not good for business. And, we can't have that, can we?

name: Go Away, Pukei!
description: I am absolutely fuming right now! I spent months, MONTHS, breaking my back to have a good harvest this year, and it takes only one day for that googly-eyed monster to wipe out all my crops. Think you can go harvest its hide for me?

name: Grasp the Great Sword
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! The Bishaten may move and attack in its own unique way, but when it hits big, it hits BIG! See for yourself what I mean, and you'll definitely find new ways to swing a great sword!

name: Hone Your Heavy Bowgun
objective: Hunt a Basarios and a Volvidon
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Strategically strike from a distance like the Volvidon, or get up close and personal like a Basarios. Add their fighting styles to the long-range, high-powered heavy bowgun, and you should learn something new!

name: Honing Your Hammer
objective: Hunt a Pukei-Pukei and a Barroth
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! The secret to hammer— Well, let's not kid ourselves here... Hammer equals thrashing and pummeling your target. Go hunt this Pukei-Pukei and Barroth and you'll know exactly what I mean!

name: Learn the Lance
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! A knight wields their lance to protect the weak—just like a Rathian fiercely protects her young! Capture the queen and you'll acquire some new Skills for your lance!

name: Miner Problem
description: Had a new guy on the team get pretty messed up by a Basarios. He came across a boulder juttin' up out of the ground and thought he hit the jackpot. Poor kid didn't know what he was doing when he planted a pickaxe square in the monster's rocky rear.

name: Rise above the Mud
description: Aaaargh! I was SO close! *sigh* Right as I was about to land the final blow on a Barroth, my feet got stuck in some mud! Not only did it proceed to stomp the crap out of me, but then it got away! Once I'm better—*ouch* I'm gonna go and finish what I started!

name: Rotten Fruit
description: It was my fur-st time seeing a Bishaten up close. It looked so playful and fur- iendly! It even started throwing fruit to me. I thought they were purr-esents but one of them blinded me with a flash and the other zapped my tail! What a meanie! Go teach it a lesson fur me!

name: Shadows Over the Frost
objective: Hunt a Khezu and a Tetranadon
description: It has come to the board's attention that one of our members has not returned from the Frost Islands. We have to assume that the trader must have been attacked thus we are requiring the assistance of a hunter. We will send out a rescue team (or cleap-up crew) once you have completed your task.

name: The Restless Swamp
description: One of our scouts tracking a Jyuratodus has gone missing in the Flooded Forest. If you would hunt the beast so that it is safe enough to dispatch a search party, it would be much appreciated. Now, hop to it-to it!

name: A Bewitching Dance
description: Ah, . A Mizutsune has become quite aggressive in the Shrine Ruins. They're normally not like this— What could have caused it to go hopping mad!? We'll investigate while you take care of it.

name: A Somniferous Elegy
description: Had a group of travelers come in last night fleeing a Somnacanth. Dang monster must have got 'em good because they're still sleepin'! I can't have guests stayin' past check out time! Hunter, can ya go do something 'bout that thing?

name: Be One with the Bow
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Speed, agility, and positioning are the signatures of the Tobi- Kadachi. Have you ever noticed how similar they are to the bow? Well, now you know, go see it for yourself!

name: Closer Than it Appears
description: I was en route to do some business when I started hearing this stomping noise behind me. It was faint at first, but then started getting louder and louder! I turn around and there's an Anjanath right behind me! I've never screamed and run so hard in my life!

name: Dissect the Dual Blades
objective: Hunt an Anjanath and a Rathian
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Fending off an Anjanath and a Rathian at the same time may sound crazy, but it's just the challenge for any hunter who's looking to develop their dual blade technique!

name: Do It for the Dango!
objective: Hunt a Nargacuga and a Jyuratodus
description: Grrrr! Stupid. Monsters. Everywhere! Why won't they leave me alone? I go to one fishing spot—Monster. I go to a different spot—ANOTHER MONSTER. Why are they so rude!? Can you go let those meanies know just how mad I am!?

name: Grasp the Gunlance
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Getting in your target's face and remaining calm is the key to unleashing the true potential of the gunlance. And no monster teaches "in-your-face" better than the Barioth!

name: Invoke the Insect Glaive
objective: Hunt a Somnacanth and an Aknosom
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Swift, graceful, dance-like: that sounds like the attacks of a Somnacanth, an Aknosom, and an insect glaive, right? Try combining the three, and see what you end up learning!

name: Learn the Long Sword
objective: Hunt a Zinogre and a Mizutsune
description: Alright, Ace, lesson time! Sharp, flowing strikes are the soul of long sword combat. The fearlessness of a Zinogre and the elegance of a Mizutsune combined are just the thing you'll need to master 'em!

name: Red Skies at Night
description: I saw it one night: a stunning firework rising up above the Caverns, so bright, the night looked like day. If that was the doing of a monster, it's got to be a pro at using fire. I need to know what it was.

name: Serpent God of Wind
description: Hunter, the Rampage approaches, roused by the Wind Serpent. Our village defenders will target Ibushi and lure it out to the Stronghold, where you'll be waiting. And then it's all up to you. Johoho! We're counting on you, now!

name: Sharpening Amber Fangs
description: My boyfriend's on his way here for my birthday. Oh, thank you! Anyway, he'll be passing through the Frost Islands to get here and I just heard that a Barioth has been spotted! Hunter, I didn't get all dolled up for nothing! You gotta get rid of it so he (and his presents) arrive safely!

name: Showdown in the Arena
description: Gather 'round, gather 'round! Today we have a show packed with fur and fury! Anjanath! Mizutsune! Zinogre! Sparks will fly! Fire will burn! Bubbles— d-does that say bubbles? It does. Uh... OK. Bubbles will, um, bubble! Who dares challenge this trifecta of trepidation!

name: Skies Flash, Clouds Boom
description: Eep! WH-WHAT WAS THAT!? Don't sneak up on me, Hunter! I-I've been on edge ever since a Zinogre j-jumped out on me! Brr...my fur's still on end from the fear...a-and static! Could y-you help me-me-meow-t?

name: Skies are Gray
description: When the skies cloud over, ya think there's rain on the way, don'tcha? Well, this time, it weren't no storm, it was a dang Tobi-Kadachi! Can't do no fishin' when you're gettin' zapped in the rear every other minute! I want that varmint gone, ya hear me!?

name: The Abyss Stares Back
description: I still see it. Even now when I close my eyes. A moving void. The darkest dark you could ever imagine. You don't even know it's there until it's too late. From the abyss of night, two streaks of red surge towards you. Before you can even react, it has you.

name: The Lava Caverns Sweep
objective: Slay a total of 20 Uroktor or Rachnoid
description: A great horde of monsters has gathered in the Lava Caverns, but I must pass through! My guards and I cannot defeat them, I know this—but I also know that a hunter as skilled as you can. Will you help us?

name: A Blaze Among Beasts
description: Got a real challenge here for ya, Squirt! Bwahaha! Look at those ears perk up! I knew it'd be right up your alley! Best these beasties and ol' Fugen will give ya a new Petalace. Sounds good, don't it!? Now go get to it!

name: A Frosty Stalemate
objective: Hunt a Goss Harag and a Tetranadon
description: Hey, um, sorry to interrupt you, but I think there's something out in the Frost Islands that "may" need your attention. These two monsters have been going at it for a while now and it seems to be getting worse. Just, uh, thought you should know.

name: A Muddy Invitation
description: Just look at me... Yuck! Covered from head to tail in mud. Meow I have to take a bath with Meowster... And you know Felynes hate baths! Can you go take care of that nasty creature while I go scrub Meowster's back?

name: A Quartet of Horns
description: UGH! I was gathering herbs for my new menu out in the Sandy Plains, and guess what? Two dumb Diablos showed up to stab my lunch dango on their horns! Grr, I want payback on those jerks!

name: A Resounding Roar
description: Did you hear that? It was that Tigrex! That monster's invaded the Plains and has been hollerin' up a storm ever since. Now all our Popo are spooked and won't budge. Can't blame 'em...they are a Tigrex's favorite snack. Please, Hunter. You gotta help us out!

name: A Whirlwind of a Stage
description: I've been suffering from a severe case of writer's block, so I asked an acquaintance of mine to set up a grand stage performance. All you have to do, Hunter, is play your part, and surely I will find the inspiration I need to finish my romance novel!

name: Advanced: Dual Calamities
objective: Hunt a Magnamalo and a Bazelgeuse
description: Magnamalo AND a Bazelgeuse!? At the SAME time!? What are we gonna do!? We're doomed I tell ya! DOOMED! There's nowhere to run! There's nowhere to hide! I'm gonna get gobbled up—No! I'm gonna get blown to bits! Maybe even both!

name: Advanced: Monsters in Ink
objective: Hunt a Goss Harag, a Tigrex, and a Mizutsune
description: Hunter Hunter HUNTER! A Goss Harag, a Tigrex, and a Mizutsune are all out in the Frost Islands right at this moment! If you'd be willing to take the three of them on, I shall observe you, painting a masterpiece of the action! It will be my finest work!

name: Advanced: Of Storm and Fire
objective: Slay a Kushala Daora and a Teostra
description: Really? TWO elder dragons!? Why, this is THE observation opportunity of two lifetimes! Here: you just slay them as you would usually, while we carry out our research. Easy, right? Nothing to worry about!

name: Advanced: Proof of Power
description: I. AM. PUMPED! Now that I'm a hunter, I cannot WAIT to see some action! And this quest is EXACTLY the type of action I'm looking for! Whattaya say, Hunter? Think you can best all three of these bad boys?

name: Advanced: Scaredy-Cat
objective: Slay a Chameleos and hunt a Rajang
description: It was so scary, Hunter! I was trying to get home when I got caught in this creepy mist. It was so thick, I could barely see my whiskers! I heard a rustling noise and when I spun around, I saw it! A two-horned demon! Please! Don't let it get me!

name: Advanced: The Fallen Comet
objective: Slay a Crimson Glow Valstrax and hunt a Rakna-kadaki
description: Oh, wow! I just saw a comet fall into the Lava Caverns! While I really wanna check it out, I'm also not trying to go there by myself. Not with all the creepy crawly things that live there. Hey, what if it wasn't a comet but that legendary elder dragon!? C'mon! Let's go!

name: Advanced: Those Crowned Apex
description: Gather 'round, gather 'round! Tonight we have a grand show of magnitude and might! Apexes galore for your viewing pleasure! Mizutsune! Rathalos! Zinogre! Who will step up to the challenge!? Come one 'n' all to find out!

name: Ancient Illusion
description: A Chameleos has shown itself— hmmm...no. A Chameleos has appeared—*sigh* A Chameleos has been spot—We know it's out there! Go hunt the cursed thing before it unleashes toadal chaos! Now, hop to it-to it!

name: Can't Kill It with Fire
description: Rakna-Kadaki inhabit a select few regions, and yet one has just been sighted in the Lava Caverns... I just don't get it-get it! All of this strange activity around the region. And now Minoto is acting strange as well...

name: Clad in Hellfire
description: What an embarrassment. My best armor was about as effective as wet paper against Magnamalo. I tell ya, that hellfire is a one-way ticket back to camp... I guess I need to hit up the Smithy again. Think you can finish up the quest for me?

name: Death From Above
description: I've never seen anything like it! From the skies I heard a distant roar and then "it" came. Like hell falling from the heavens, fire rained down, scorching the earth. Time almost stood still as everything around me was consumed by flame.

name: Evil Afoot
description: A d-d-demon, I tell you! A demon! No one's safe with that thing around! No one! The Felynes, the dango, the twins—ME! Oh my Gog! ME! I'm not safe! AHHHHHH! Hunter! What are you doing!? Go get rid of that thing!

name: Fought, Failed, Fired Up
objective: Hunt a Diablos and an Anjanath
description: *sigh* I took on a Diablos and failed... I took on an Anjanath—failed. I just can't anymore. How can it even be done? You've challenged all sorts of beasts, surely these are nothing to you. Maybe if I watch you defeat them, it'll rekindle the fire inside me.

name: It's Gonna Get You!
description: Mom always says, "If you don't behave, the snow demon from the Frost Islands is gonna come and gobble you up!" Yeah, right! There's no snow demon out there! ...Is there? Uh, on second thought, maybe you could go check for me?

name: Master Utsushi's Challenge Part 1
description: Yo, Ace! You've been making some totally gnarly progress recently! Does a man good to see his pupil train so hard! In fact, let's kick it up a notch! Got just the quest for you, and it's a real banger!

name: Master Utsushi's Challenge Part 2
description: Yo, Ace! You've been making some totally gnarly progress recently! Does a man good to see his pupil train so hard! In fact, let's kick this up a notch! Got just the quest for you, and it's a real banger!

name: May Fire Quell Fury
description: Bein' flexible in any situation's the mark of a true hunter, and I've got just the quest to test ya! If you can capture me a Rajang, you pass—and ya get yourself a new Petalace too! Now, go get to it!

name: Occupational Hazards
objective: Hunt a Rajang and a Zinogre
description: I love when monsters keep destroying my carts and my livelihood—said no trader ever! First a Lagombi, then a Diablos, then two Volvidon, and NOW a Rajang and Zinogre! I just want, for once, to get from point A to point B without getting beat up by monsters!

name: Omnidirectional Threats
objective: Hunt a Rakna-Kadaki and a Khezu
description: Hi, I'd like to speak to whoever is in charge here. Yes, I heard that there were two monsters in the Lava Caverns. This is completely unacceptable! If something is not done about this right away, I WILL be contacting the guild to file a complaint!

name: Return of the Bazelgeuse
description: That cursed thing has returned! And with it, fire and destruction! Where it will strike next, we do not know. All we can do is follow the trail of devastation it has left behind. Hunter we ask that you stop this terror from the skies!

name: Return of the Bazelgeuse
description: That cursed thing has returned! And with it, fire and destruction! Where it will strike next, we do not know. All we can do is follow the trail of devastation it has left behind. Hunter we ask that you stop this terror from the skies!

name: Ruckus in the Ruins
objective: Hunt an Almudron and a Mizutsune
description: Whoa! It is TOTALLY going down right now in the Shrine Ruins! One minute there's mud everywhere. Then the next, there's bubbles everywhere. Mud. Bubbles. Mud! Bubbles! I think you need to go out and clean up this mess!

name: Seared Situation
description: Bunny Dango slow-cooked over lava: sounds super yummy, right!? I was gonna go out to the Lava Caverns to try it out... WAS until I heard there was a Rathalos and Magnamalo. How rude! Could you go get rid of them please!?

name: Serpent Goddess of Thunder
description: At last! The chance to end this miserable calamity is at hand! You must defeat Thunder Serpent Narwa once and for all! Hunter of Kamura, go and be victorious! I and the rest of your family are awaiting your triumphant return!

name: Subterranean Disturbances
description: We've recently been getting earthquakes, as if something is shuffling beneath our feet. Everyone's scared and rightly so! It's hard enough trying to keep it together when we can barely keep things on the shelves!

name: The Allmother
description: Ibushi and Narwa have convened at the Coral Palace—that means we're running out of time... You must give them both the paddling of their lives, and break the chains shackling our village!

name: The Avaricious Apex Arzuros
description: I've spent a lot time hiking through the Ruins and I've seen more than my share of Arzuros... But the one I saw earlier was no ordinary Arzuros. I think this one was of those Apex monsters I've heard about. And if it was I won't be taking any more hiking trips through the Ruins anytime soon.

name: The Crimson Glow
description: Ancient texts speak of the Crimson Glow Valstrax as the "Scourge of the World." Well, now that it's returned, we won't let it destroy the peace that Kamura has fought so hard for! Time to hop to it-to it!

name: The Devastating Apex Diablos
description: I saw it! I saw that terrifying—Wait... What was it I saw? A three-eyed goat? No... A beady-eyed ghost? Dern it! OH! It was a Diablos! But it wasn't a Diablos...know what I mean? No...? Well, it had horns...And... Well, shoot. I forget... Just go hunt the dang thing!

name: The Emperor of Flame
description: A Teostra has been spotted in the Lava Caverns. Wreathed in flame, Teostra are of such a fierce and deadly nature that the Guild keeps track of their movements whenever possible. You must leap into action at once and extinguish this threat!

name: The Evil Star from Beyond
description: The Valstrax has returned. If you plan on takin' it on, beware its wings! If they don;t burn you to a crisp, they'll dang sure poke you pull of holes. Be quick and stay on your toes out there! Got it? Well, good luck to ya!

name: The Fearsome Apex Rathalos
description: Talk about a bad fur day! Just when my tail healed up, I come across an even meaner Rathalos! An Apex one, too! As soon as it spotted me it barfed up this meowssive fireball! At this point, the fur on my tail will never grow back...

name: The Graceful Apex Rathian
description: I TOTALLY thought that Rathian was 'bout done for, 'cause it looked like, SUPER beat up. But then it got mad, and it was, like, soooo STRONG! Like, what even is its problem, y'know? Anyway, can you hunt it for me? Thaaanks!

name: The Harlequin Apex Mizutsune
description: Good evening, Master Hunter. I hate to disturb you in this late hour, but I have received word that an Apex Mizutsune was spotted along my employer's route home. I ask that you guarantee his safe return.

name: The Steely Storm
description: Johoho! This quest will just "blow" your socks off, Hunter! *ahem* Pardon me! The Kushala Daora is an elder dragon shrouded in mystery. How they are able to summon tempests simply, joho, "blows" our mind! Johoho! *ahem*

name: The Voltaic Apex Zinogre
description: I was out on patrol in the Ruins, when suddenly, lightning struck all around me. I thought perhaps I had angered the gods enshrined there. But it wasn't any god, it was worse. It was a Zinogre. But this was no ordinary Zinogre. Tread carefully out there, Hunter.

A Grizzly Encounter
description: What are we gonna do, Hunter? WHAT ARE WE GONNA DO!? An Arzuros attacked the latest delivery of honey into Kamura and now there are no sweets— WHAT!? Who cares if they are OK! Did you hear me? NO SWEETS!

name: A Snowball's Chance...
description: I absolutely cannot believe how awful my luck is. No way that thing could've hit me! There I was...bobbing...weaving. Zigging...zagging. Just when I thought I had gotten away from this Lagombi *BAM* me and all my goods crushed by a snowball. Unbelievable...

name: Hot Topic Hooligans
objective: Slay a total of 20 Zamite or Bnahabra
description: I heard from my brother's mother's cousin that the Frost Islands are crawling with monsters these days. And get this, my mailman's uncle was just ruffed up out there the other day. It used to be such a nice place. Wish someone'd do something about it...

name: Jumped in the Frost Islands
description: Psst! Hey, pal. I just got ruffed up by a gang of Izuchi and their "great" bozo leader. They took my pouch, my zenny—even my pants! Think ya could do me a solid and take care of 'em for me? And maybe, uh, get me some pants too, huh?

name: No Cure for the Common Baggi
description: YUCK! Fur-st a Great Baggi *sniff* spits all over me! *sniff* THEN I fall asleep out in the Frost Islands, and now *sniff* I think I'm coming down with something! Nya...Nya... *sniff* Nya...NYACHOO! *sniff*

name: Off the Beaten Path
objective: Slay a total of 20 Izuchi or Altaroth
description: My friend and I heard about this amazing secret spot up in the Shrine Ruins where you can relax and watch the Torchbugs glow. We wanted to take a hike up there and check it out, but there's a bunch of monsters in the way...

name: Shady Monster
description: SAy tHeRe, hUNter~ eVEr sEeN A mOnSTeR tHAt hOPs oN One lEg? i hAvE...aND i'Ve nEveR bEen tHe sAMe sINcE—Hahaha! *hack* Those old ghost stories don't scare me none. HOW ABOUT YOU!?

name: Tired and Feathered
description: Thinks he's number one, does he? Just because he snatched my Gold Gargwa Egg? Well, you're gonna show him. You got that!? I'm number one around here. I'M NUMBER ONE!

name: Wroggi Place, Wroggi Time
description: I was out on my morning jog through the Ruins and out pops a Great Wroggi spittin' poison all over my new running shoes. What is wrong with these monsters!? Hunter, please avenge my shoes, would you?

name: A Pale Shadow
description: "So...so...cold... Whiskers fur-ozen... Tail fur-ozen... Paws— Wha...What's that? A fur-iendly smile? So...warm...meow... Everything...warm—" (The diary ends there. You feel compelled to rescue its owner.)

name: Blasted Basarios!
description: *cough* Dang Basarios! *wheeze* One minute you're sittin' on what you thought was a rock, tryin' to get the dirt out of yer boots, *hack* and the next, you're huffin' *cough* all kinds of who-knows-what! *hack*

name: Bouncing Brawlers
objective: Hunt a Lagombi and a Tetranadon
description: I haven't slept in days and it's all because of those two stupid monsters. Fighting all day... Fighting all night! They never let up! The roaring. The rumbling. I can't take it anymore! Please, I need some sleep! SHUT THEM UP!

name: Dawn of the Kestodon
description: What do I do? WHAT DO I DO!? There's Kestodon all around me! Here, there, yonder, whither— they're everywhere, I tell ya, EVERYWHERE! Even in my mind! There's nowhere left to run! You gotta stop 'em before it's too late!

name: Dead Ringer
description: Me and my big mouth... I saw a picture of a Tetranadon and blurted out "It looks exactly like Master Hojo!" He overheard me and now he thinks I was talking about a Mizutsune! If he finds out the truth, he'll croak!

name: Fried and Baptized
objective: Hunt a Royal Ludroth and a Rathian
description: I tend to ignore these little "tiffs" between monsters while out in the field. Especially since I have a special cloak to protect me. But it becomes increasingly difficult to ignore when the forest is flooding and burning at the same time...

name: Hide, Hide, Hide!
objective: Slay a total of 20 Jagras or Ludroth
description: Darling, a special order has come in for a very special client and I'm all out of materials. Be a dear and fetch some for me, will you? Only the finest materials will do. None of that faux nonsense! Now, off you go!

name: I Want Off This Ride
description: I was coming home FUR-OM WORK when suddenly I SAW A BISHATEN spinning on its TAIL AND SUDDENLY it started spinning AROUND ME! Then everything STARTED SPINNING! And then I started SPINNING! AND meow I can't stop! PLEASE HELP!

name: Reinventing the Wheel
description: Wheels get stuck in the sand, limiting trade across deserts; and yet, Volvidon traverse the Plains with ease—wait, that's it! Allow me to observe how a Volvidon rolls, and I shall design an unstoppable wheel!

name: So Muddy Hardheaded!
description: "You're so hardheaded, you'd put a Barroth to shame!" Heh, can you believe my wife said that to me? She thinks my head's harder than a Barroth's! There's no way! So I'm goin' out to get me a Barroth skull to prove it! And ain't no one gonna change my mind!

name: The Flooding Flooded Forest
description: It's utter chaos! Our couriers are under attack from a Royal Ludroth and its mates! "Mates" as in females, by the way, not frie—wait, that doesn't even— Look, we just need you to hunt that Royal Ludroth ASAP!

name: The Path to Royalty
description: Oh, what I wouldn't give to be a queen! "Queen of the Land"? Who wouldn't love a title like that!? Perhaps I may learn a thing or two from the queen herself! Valiant Knight of Kamura! I order you to hunt a Rathian!

name: The Rampage Approaches
description: Well then, Hunter, the Rampage is nearing Kamura. The villages will defend the areas surrounding the Stronghold, while you fend off any monsters that make it in. Johoho! Good luck!

name: Way of the Pukei
description: Master Utsushi does those monster impressions, right? Maybe if I, like, learned one, we'd have something in common. I bet I could do Pukei-Pukei. Seems easy. I'm already pretty good at sticking out my tongue. If you hunt one for me, I can watch and take notes!

name: A Few Bumps Along the Way
description: A buddy of mine told me about this "great shortcut" he found. The road was so bumpy I fell off my cart right into a cactus patch. And to make matters worse, a Diablos appeared out of nowhere and turned my cart into splinters... Why do these things always happen to me!?

name: A Friend in Need
description: My Popo, Posey, is my best friend. She helps me every day and is the sweetest companion I've ever had. A Tigrex was spotted along my trade route and you know what they do to Popo... Hunter, please. I can't lose Posey. If I lose her, I lose everything!

name: Beastly Chaos
objective: Hunt a Tigrex and a Goss Harag
description: Oh meow! A Tigrex and a Goss Harag are going berserk out in the Frost Islands! If someone doesn't stop 'em, the island's gonna get carved up like a scratching post! Help!

name: Beckoning Slumber
description: I've been suffering from insomnia... So I figured, hey, why don't I create a sedative using Somnacanth powder? At this point, I don't care how crazy it sounds. Just get me that powder, please.

name: Bully of the Caverns
description: I can see why that Anjanath likes to bully all those little monsters. Them Raths always pickin' on 'em for having those li'l stubby "wings" and a funny lookin' schnoz. But that don't make it right. I don't like bullies. And I won't have any of it!

name: Champion of the Caverns
description: Meow, I've seen my share of Raths before. Never thought they were that tough, just fly around and yowl at ya. Mewboy, I was so wrong... I got the big idea to take one on, paw-to-claw, and it one only took one fireball for me to hightail it out of there! Youch!

name: Disastrously Beautiful
description: Ah. A Barroth, Tobi-Kadachi, and Magnamalo—quite the trio. Is anyone capable of dancing with three such aggressive partners, one after the other? If you intend to take to this stage, I'll be your audience.

name: Down 'n' Dirty
description: Doggone Almudron! That thing came through the farm slingin' its mud all over the dern place. Now there's mud all over my dern crops. All in my dern house. Heck, even got mud in my dern pants! Well, least the Poogies is happy...

name: Hellfire
description: That dreadful Magnamalo has been spotted! Quick, Hunter, you must leap into action at once! We cannot allow it to feed on the hordes or it may become too powerful to defeat! No time to waste! Hop to it-to it!

name: My Muse the Mizutsune
description: My husband is one of those artsy- fartsy types, you know the kind. Sees a sunset...cries. Well, he heard Mizutsune are "creatures that inspire creativity" so he ran off with his easel to find one. *sigh* Can you go save him for me?

name: Tail to Tail
objective: Hunt a Bishaten and an Almudron
description: Both Bishaten and Almudron are known for using their powerful tails when they attack. I'm collecting information on these monsters. Could you possibly assist me? I need to ascertain which tail is stronger. The one like a fist, or the one like a whip?

name: The Blizzard Blender
description: Yo, I heard those Goss Harag's can turn their arms into these sick ice blades that'll carve a hunter up like, "Shwa! Shwa! Shwashwashwa SHWA!" Dude, I gotta see it! Come on, go pick a fight with one! Just, uh, don't get all "shwa-shwa-shwa"-ed up out there!

name: Twilit Twin Stars
description: It was a quiet night in the Ruins; that's when I saw two red stars glowing in the darkness. I felt a gust of wind, and the next thing I knew, I awoke on a hospital bed. I did not know such frightening things exist out there...

name: Wavering Moon and Thunder
description: My guards have turned craven after hearing of a Zinogre in the area. Nonetheless, I must press on through the Forest, no matter what... Which is why I implore you, brave Hunter, to vanquish the beast instead.

name: White Knight vs. Hunter
description: I am a warrior, roaming these lands to hone my skills. I've come to the Islands to observe the so-called "White Knight." I long to challenge it, however, it is custom in my country to allow you the honor first. Have at it, brave Hunter!

name: Zigzagging Zapper
description: Blargh! I was trying to hunt a stupid Tobi-Kadachi but the squirrely monster just wouldn't stay still! When I finally got an opening to strike, it scurried off and hid in a tree! Is it gonna come down anytime soon? You know what? I'm outta here! I don't got all day for this!

name: A Sinking Feeling
objective: Slay a total of 15 Hermitaur or Velociprey
description: After getting my first ship, I was tasked with ferrying knights to the Jungle, but Hermitaur and Velociprey roam the shores! I don't like the look of this... I JUST became captain! I'm not ready to go down with the ship!

name: BRRRR Plus ZZZzzz Equals?
objective: Hunt a Lagombi and a Great Baggi
description: Help! I was fishin' in the Frost Islands, when bam! a Lagombi was all like RAWR with a snow- ball, and I was all BRRRR, and then boom! A Great Baggi went all BAAARFFF, and I was all ZZZzzzzz...

name: Barroth to a Great Start
description: Ta-daaah! I invented this revolutionary fertilizer by mixing all sorts of stuff with a Barroth tail! I'll make a killin' if I can mass-produce this, but I ran outta tail! Can ya go hunt a Barroth for me?

name: Buggin' Out!
objective: Slay a total of 20 Vespoid or Hornetaur
description: Ew! EW! Get them away from me! Gross, gross, GROSS! Like, why didn't someone tell me the Jungle would be literally CRAWLING with bugs? Monsters? OK. But, bugs? BUGS? HELLO! I did NOT sign up for this, OK? Yuck.

name: Catnap Ruined
description: All the shade in the Shrine Ruins makes it purr-fect fur napping, but two Arzuros are making such a ruckus with their tussling, I can't catch a wink! I need you to get back my mew-ty sleep, Hunter!

name: It Could be Worse...
description: So funny story, I get barbequed by an Aknosom so I stop, drop, and roll, right? But I keep rolling and rolling...and rolling...and roll— Anyway, I'm all dizzy now and my buns are toasted. Think you can go and finish the job for me?

name: Need a Hunter, ASAP!
description: es, yes. Greetings. Now if you don't mind, I didn't come all this way for formalities. I came here to research monsters. And I intend to do just that! I require that you hunt a Kulu-Ya-Ku immediately. Well... What are you waiting for?

name: Reap What You Saw
description: I was having the darndest time trying to cut my grass—'bout cut my dang hand off—when I seen the darndest thing! This darn monster did one li'l twirl and mowed down just about everything around it! Maybe if I watch you hunt one, I can figure out how it does that.

name: Supply Line Shell Game
description: I came up with the pur-fect recipe to help meow-t hunters and researchers in the field, but the ingredients can only be found in Daimyo Hermitaur territory! Can you help me secure my supplies by removing those crabs from the culinary equation?

name: Tetranadon Blockade
description: As I said previously, there's a Tetranadon making a nuisance of itself in the Jungle. This mission is essential for securing safe passage between Elgado and Kamura. Now then, , the Fierce! Show me what you're made of!

name: The Good, the Bad, and Lagombi
description: Hunter, good... Lagombi, bad... Wirebugs, good... Snowball, bad... Big ears, good... Sonic Bomb, bad... Many bombs, good... Forget bombs, bad...

name: The Jungle Guidebook
description: For the sake of my publication, I need you to hunt three monsters. I wish to record the nitty-gritty details of these fearsome beasts! Once complete, merchants and travelers will be able to navigate the Jungle safely!

name: The Red Rolling Terror
description: omeone! Help pleeeeeeease! I crossed paths with a Volvidon and it chased me up a tree! You gotta hurry! It keeps spittin' at me and lickin' the bottom of my boots! I'm sendin' this message via bug— sorry for the bug goo in advance!

name: Uninvited Guest
description: So a Daimyo Hermitaur found its way into the Shrine Ruins, huh? Well, time for a little Kamura welcome. But be careful, I hear that shell of theirs is darn near impossible to penetrate. Not a problem for a smart hunter like you! Bwahaha! Now go get to it!

name: You Had Me at Poofy
description: OK, picture this: Royal Ludroth stuffed animals. Eh? EH? You can totally see it, right? With their little poofy mane, they'd be a hit! And why stop there? Kitchen sponges, bath sponges!? All we need is a little..."product research."

name: [REDACTED]
description: A certain VIP may or may not be set to visit the Outpost, but two Great Wroggi may or may not have appeared on the road in. We may or may not need you to hunt it.

name: A Dangerous Dare ♪
objective: Hunt a Rathian and a Bishaten
description: Nothing wrong with peaceful days, but a guy needs excitement from time to time. Want to do a test of courage tonight at the Shrine Ruins? Oh, I won't be going, of course. Tell me how it went, and I'll give you an armor recipe!

name: A Fond Fur-Well
objective: Hunt a Tobi-Kadachi and a Tetranadon
description: Soon my fur-iend's moving away across the sea and I wanna send 'em some flowers from the Jungle, but two monsters are stomping up the place! Hope there's enough left fur a bouquet...

name: A Shocking, Sloppy Synthesis
objective: Hunt a Jyuratodus and a Tobi-Kadachi
description: One locks you up, one knocks you out—mud and lightning's a scary combo, ain't it! Maybe it wouldn't faze a fierce hunter, but... Heh, as if! Anyway, I got a double-header request here, right up your alley.

name: BZZZZZ or ZZZZzzzz Pt. 2
objective: Hunt a Khezu and a Somnacanth
description: Ugh! My soon to be ex-boyfriend has done lost his mind! He thinks Somnacanth are longer than Khezu. HELLO! The stretchy necks!? Duh! I've had it with him. I'm SO done... Anyway, can you go out there and give Khezzy my number? Thanks!

name: Bird Wyvern Jamboree
objective: Hunt an Aknosom and a Kulu-Ya-Ku
description: We've gotten word of a merchant lost deep in the Shrine Ruins. We have a bead on their location, but we've also gotten word of an Aknosom and a Kulu-Ya-Ku there. Hunt down both, and we'll rescue the merchant.

name: In Pursuit of the Khezuit
description: Have you heard of Khezuits? White fruit rarely found in arctic regions where Khezu live. It even looks like one! Wouldn't you know it, one's just about to ripen! I'll grab the fruit, you handle the Khezu.

name: Messed Up Situation
description: This is a nightmare... This Jyuratodus jumped out of the sludge and attacked me and now my stuff's all caked in mud! This is my best suit, too! I'm gonna go take a bath, can you take that punk to the cleaners?

name: Now That's What I Call Great!
description: Welcome to the Arena, folks! And boy do we have a show for you tonight! The Greatest of the Greats are all here and it's about to GO DOWN! These monsters are ready to fight tooth and nail for the title! Let's rumble!

name: Pent-Up Frustrations
description: commute through the Sandy Plains to trade at the Outpost, but when night falls, there's this weird rock wall blocking my route. What gives? Now I have to take the long way around... Argh! Somebody do something!

name: Pinecone Pelting Panic
description: I've been thinking of creating some nourishing dango for all you brave hunters. I hear that the pinecones hoarded by Blood Orange Bishaten contain a healthy sap. Could you keep the monkeys busy while I purr-ocure the pinecones? Thanks!

name: Plant Probe Pests
objective: Slay a total of 15 Gajau or Ludroth
description: I'm trying to conduct a botanical survey in the Flooded Forest, but monsters keep getting in my way, ESPECIALLY those Gajau and Ludroth. I'm sick of this! Please, I just want to finish my work! Get rid of 'em so I can do my job already!

name: Poison Drops in the Sand
description: Wowzers! A Pukei-Pukei in the Sandy Plains! They're cute an' all with their googly eyes and colorful feathers, but what's NOT cute is all that poison they drip everywhere! It gets all over everything! Even other critters!

name: Provoking an Anjanath's Wrath
description: A Wyverian researcher has taken it upon himself to venture out in the Flooded Forest alone. It comes as no surprise that going out there by himself was a stupid idea. And now he's in danger. My apologies, but could I ask you to rescue him?

name: Rumble in the Jungle
description: I've been hearing this sound from the Jungle lately—a kind of electric buzzing? I admit I'm curious, but I get shivers thinking about what awaits at the source. Think you could take a look, Hunter?

name: Shrine Ruined
objective: Hunt a Great Izuchi and a Rathian
description: I went to the Shrine Ruins to take in the ancient architecture, but these two beasties started goin' at it! A fight between those two would bring down all the old buildings. Go tell 'em to take it somewhere else!

name: Skulking Among the Sand
description: Heeelp! I went hunting in the Sandy Purr-lains with my meowster, but we can't handle a single monster—much less THREE! I hate to say it, but we aren't up to scratch for this! We need a veteran to take the reins!

name: Somnacanth Sleep Aid
description: *yawn* I'm a sleeping fiend, so I wanna make a pillow that's up to the nappy task. Getting *yawn* knocked out by a Somnacanth's like a gift from the sandman himself. If you hunt one for me, it'd really *yawn* help my snooze cruise.

name: Sour Grapes
description: I've been searching for fruit in the Jungle, but keep coming up short. Blue fur and tail marks tells me this is the work of a Bishaten. This can't go on forever, so I need you to hunt me into a better harvest!

name: The Alabaster Devourer
description: Feet trudge through falling snow. Naught but my footsteps, no sound, alone? I turn my gaze to the crunchy crunch—wet, gaping maw, to make me its lunch! I run, run, to no avail. Someone, uh, out...me...bail?

name: The Assault of the Scarlet Tengu
description: A Blood Orange Bishaten has been frequently attacking other monsters in the Shrine Ruins. They are fiercely territorial species and if this one makes its nest here, I'm afraid it will attract more of them. Deal with the beast at once!

name: The Queen's Garden
description: I aspire to charming conduct becoming of a lovely lady. That's why I want to observe the graciousness of the queen inhabiting the Jungle. I'll observe from the flowers. You'll protect me, won't you?

name: A Keen-Eyed Observation
objective: Hunt a Tobi-Kadachi and a Magnamalo
description: Salutations, Hunter. I would ask your assistance in a Fanged Wyvern survey. There are many survey candidates, but this time we seek a Tobi-Kadachi and a Magnamalo. We appreciate your cooperation.

name: A Sandy Spider Nest
description: My sister went to the Sandy Plains on an investigation, but only her Cohoot came back, delivering an awful message: Rakna-Kadaki have her pinned down there. If anything happens to her, I... I... Please, Hunter! You must help!

name: A Tale of Two Titans
objective: Hunt a Garangolm and a Somnacanth
description: I felt it that day! The tale of a Garangolm and a Somnacanth— of a great man in love with a songstress! Still, peace isn't enough to show their love! I'll watch from the shadows, you get their hearts pumping!

name: Desert Lost and Found
description: My li'l bro suddenly spouted off about heading to the Sandy Plains. When I dragged the reason out of him, he said his buddy lost his "treasure" there. What's a bro to do? I'll comb the sand, you watch my back.

name: Freedom from a Frigid Future!
description: Aaaaah! Arctic monsters are inching ever closer to our village! At this rate, we'll be covered in ice until we can't even sleep at night! Just thinking about it gives me chills! You've gotta stop them!

name: Garangolm Gone Mad
description: We've received an urgent message that a Garangolm is going berserk. If we don't do something soon, I'm afraid someone might get seriously injured or worse! Well, Hunter, can we leave this one to you?

name: In His Master's Footsteps
description: Someday I wanna be just like my master so I train every day in the Shrine Ruins. Well, I used to train every day, until all those monsters showed up. Can you get rid of 'em so I can get back to training?

name: Keep it Busy
description: Ugh! As if I didn't have enough paperwork as it is, and now I have to write down what I just got finished talking to you about... Talk about inefficient! Anyway, you know the deal: You hunt the monster, I procure the Qurio!

name: My Ceanataur Gently Weeps
description: I had planned a concert tour by boat, but as soon as we got the instruments loaded up and shipped off, a Shogun Ceanataur appeared to block our sea route. If you could hunt it, that'd be music to my ears!

name: Nocturnal Nuisances
objective: Hunt an Anjanath and a Tobi-Kadachi
description: We've been getting more and more reports of Anjanath and Tobi-Kadachi assaults in the Jungle as of late. Guarding the night roads is our job, but their ferocity is overwhelming and many a guard has been injured. Could you do something about them?

name: Oh, My Garsh Harag
description: My son loves playin' outside, and Jeez Louise, it's gettin' pretty cold out there. If I don't make him some warm clothes he's gonna catch cold, dontcha know! I hear Goss Harag materials make a toasty coat, think ya can get me some?

name: Pollution Problems
objective: Slay a total of 15 Ceanataur or Remobra
description: Remobras and Ceanataurs are poppin' up everywhere in the Flooded Forest, pollutin' the waters with their poison. Soon the whole area'll turn into one big poison swamp! Do something before all the water turns purple!

name: Purging Hatred
description: *channeling* There exists a creature burning with hatred that stalks the frozen hell searching for souls to consume. For its sins, it must be... "purified." I will prepare the ritual to cleanse its spirit, you release the beast from its mortal coil!

name: Rock, Razor, Pincers
objective: Hunt a Daimyo Hermitaur and a Shogun Ceanataur
description: Come one, come all! Today's catch is sure to get your mouth waterin'! But don't whip your garlic butter out just yet! These two crabs are boilin' mad! It's out of the frying pan, into the fire with these two! If you can handle the heat, dinner's served!

name: Shadow in the Jungle
description: I am taught to be one with the shadows but never have I seen a shadow move through the Jungle at such tremendous speed. What could it have been? An assassin from a rival clan? A spirit? Nevertheless, such a threat cannot be allowed to exist. Eliminate it.

name: Shady Activity
description: Hey, you! Yes, YOU! I heard you're going after the two Nargacuga in the Flooded Forest! As a dyed-in- the-thickfur Nargacuga fan, I can't let you! What's that? I can use their materials to make cute Narga-goods? Well, OK. JUST THIS ONCE!

name: Soft or Spotty?
objective: Slay a total of 15 Gowngoats or Boggi
description: I'm trying to come up with the design for a new dress, and I want to base it on a monster! The fluffy Gowngoat, or the cute li'l spotted Boggi, which should I choose!? I can't decide! Go and check them out, please!

name: Stitching a Wintry Wardrobe
objective: Hunt an Aurora Somnacanth and a Magnamalo
description: Lovely cloth, splendid thread, a sturdy needle—all I need to sew a dress! Now it's just a matter of design. I'd love to see an Aurora Somnacanth amid the icy tundra. Could you escort me to the Frost Islands?

name: Studying Starvation Effects
objective: Hunt an Anjanath and a Pukei-Pukei
description: Does hunger lower the abilities of all organisms? I need you to look into this! Hunt the two gluttons: Anjanath and Pukei-Pukei, and tell me how they stack up, you know, compared to usual. Got something for ya when you get back!

name: Tempering the Fierce
description: Well, well, well, Squirt! Tales of your deeds have made it all the way back to Kamura! We're all proud of ya, so we gotcha a li'l something. But we ain't givin' it to ya, until we test your mettle! Sound good? Now go get to it!

name: The Hot and Cold Treatment
objective: Hunt a Goss Harag and a Blood Orange Bishaten
description: Hasn't the tem-purr-ature in the Citadel been all over the place lately? Ice chunks and flaming pinecones flying all over... My cargo's done fur at this rate. Do something about the purr-rojectiles at least!

name: The Mother of All Medicines!?
description: I've learned my trade by walking hill and dale gathering ingredients for decades. Mix Tobi-Kadachi needles, Rathian spikes, and Hermitaur shell together to stop bug bite itches! Ouch, they got me again!

name: Trial of the Almudron
description: I have to hunt an Almudron as a "test of courage," but look at me! This armor weighs more than I do. Ugh... Why do they want ME, of all people, to test my courage? There's none to test! Can you hunt this stupid monster for me?

name: Troublemaker Trio
description: Could be my imagination, but the monsters of the Flooded Forest look spooked these days. I asked around, and a trio of troublemaking monsters seem to be the culprits. Think you can go check it out?

name: White Knight on Ice
description: My subordinates were quarreling with each other on a Barioth hunt, and their lack of unity caused the mission to end in failure—and fractures. We have other duties that we must attend to... Could perhaps you finish the job for us?

name: Life is Full of Ups and Downs
